title: Making Predictions
subject: Language Arts
description: Be a reading detective — guess what happens next!
steps: A prediction is a smart guess about what happens NEXT in a story.
Use clues: the pictures, the title, and what already happened.
Say: 'I predict... because...' — the BECAUSE is your clue!
Keep reading to check: was your prediction right? It's okay if not — detectives adjust!

questions.correct: A smart guess about what happens next
options: A smart guess about what happens next

questions.prompt: What clues help you predict? Pick ALL!
questions.hint: Clues are IN and AROUND the story.

questions.prompt: Anansi sees a cookie jar and licks his lips. What do you predict?
questions.correct: He will try to get a cookie
questions.hint: Use the clue — licking lips means hungry!
options: He will try to get a cookie

questions.prompt: Your prediction was wrong. What should you do?
questions.correct: Keep reading and make a new one
options: Keep reading and make a new one
